brief:
Palestinian and Moroccan footballers share the top position among Arab nationalities represented in Egypt's Premier League for the 2026-2027 season, each contributing 12 players to the division, Shehab Wire reported. The balance reflects the significant presence of both nations' athletes in Egyptian professional football.

The tied representation underscores the competitive strength of Palestinian and Moroccan players in the region's most prominent league. Neither country holds a numerical advantage in the roster count, marking an unusual parity at the leadership level of Arab participation in the Egyptian top flight during the upcoming campaign.

title: Palestinian and Moroccan players lead Arab representation in Egyptian league
